fields.title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
fields.description: Fluffy pancakes with a bright citrus lift from lemon zest and creamy ricotta.
fields.ingredients:
1.5 cups flour
2 tbsp sugar
2 tsp baking powder
0.5 tsp salt
1 cup ricotta cheese
1 cup milk
2 eggs
Zest of 1 lemon
2 tbsp melted butter
fields.instructions:
Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, mix ricotta, milk, eggs, lemon zest, and melted butter.
Fold wet ingredients into dry until just combined; do not overmix.
Cook 1/4-cup portions on a hot buttered griddle, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve warm with maple syrup and extra lemon zest.

fields.title: Sheet Pan Sausage and Vegetables
fields.description: One tray, minimal cleanup, and dinner is on the table in half an hour.
fields.ingredients:
4 Italian sausages
2 bell peppers, sliced
1 red onion, sliced
2 cups baby potatoes, halved
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
Salt and pepper to taste
fields.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F (220C).
Toss potatoes with 2 tbsp oil, paprika, salt, and pepper; roast 15 minutes.
Add sausages, peppers, and onion to the tray with remaining oil.
Roast another 20 minutes, flipping once, until sausages are cooked through.
Serve straight from the tray.

fields.title: Weeknight Chicken Tikka Masala
fields.description: A quicker, weeknight-friendly take on the classic — rich, spiced, and comforting.
fields.ingredients:
1.5 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1 cup plain yogurt
2 tbsp tikka masala spice blend
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, grated
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 cup heavy cream
2 tbsp butter
Cilantro for garnish
fields.instructions:
Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the spice blend for at least 20 minutes.
Sear marinated chicken in a hot pan until browned; set aside.
In the same pan, saute onion, garlic, and ginger with remaining spices.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and butter, then return chicken to the sauce.
Simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Garnish with cilantro.

fields.title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Stew
fields.description: A completely plant-based, one-pot stew that freezes beautifully for later.
fields.ingredients:
1.5 cups green or brown lentils
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can diced tomatoes
6 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
fields.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot; saute onion, carrots, and celery until softened.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in lentils, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30-35 minutes, until lentils are tender.
Season to taste with salt and pepper before serving.

fields.title: Classic French Onion Soup
fields.description: Deeply caramelized onions in a rich broth, finished with melted gruyere toast.
fields.ingredients:
6 large yellow onions, thinly sliced
4 tbsp butter
1 tsp sugar
8 cups beef or vegetable broth
0.5 cup dry white wine
1 bay leaf
Baguette slices
2 cups grated gruyere cheese
fields.instructions:
Melt butter in a large pot; add onions and sugar.
Cook onions low and slow, stirring occasionally, for 45 minutes until deeply golden.
Deglaze with white wine, scraping up any browned bits.
Add broth and bay leaf; simmer 20 minutes.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top with baguette slices and cheese, and broil until bubbly and golden.

fields.title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
fields.description: Nutty brown butter and a touch of flaky salt take these cookies over the top.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup butter
1 cup brown sugar
0.5 cup white sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
2.75 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
0.5 tsp salt
2 cups chocolate chips
Flaky sea salt for topping
fields.instructions:
Brown the butter in a saucepan until nutty and golden; cool slightly.
Whisk browned butter with brown and white sugar until glossy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt until just combined.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Chill dough at least 30 minutes, then scoop onto trays and bake at 350F (175C) for 11-13 minutes.
Sprinkle with flaky salt right out of the oven.

fields.title: No-Knead Rustic Bread
fields.description: A crusty, bakery-style loaf that needs almost no hands-on effort.
fields.ingredients:
3 cups flour
1.5 tsp salt
0.5 tsp instant yeast
1.5 cups warm water
fields.instructions:
Mix flour, salt, and yeast in a large bowl.
Stir in water until a shaggy, sticky dough forms.
Cover and let rest at room temperature for 12-18 hours.
Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a round, and let rest 30 minutes.
Bake in a preheated covered Dutch oven at 450F (230C) for 30 minutes, then uncovered for 15 more, until deeply golden.

fields.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
fields.description: Prep it the night before and wake up to a ready-to-eat breakfast.
fields.ingredients:
0.5 cup rolled oats
0.5 cup milk of choice
0.25 cup yogurt
1 tbsp honey or maple syrup
0.5 cup mixed berries
1 tbsp chia seeds
fields.instructions:
Combine oats, milk, yogurt, sweetener, and chia seeds in a jar.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Top with fresh berries before serving.

fields.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
fields.description: Slow-stirred arborio rice turns silky and rich with mushrooms and parmesan.
fields.ingredients:
1.5 cups arborio rice
8 oz mixed mushrooms, sliced
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
5 cups warm vegetable broth
0.5 cup dry white wine
0.75 cup grated parmesan
3 tbsp butter
2 tbsp olive oil
fields.instructions:
Saute mushrooms in olive oil until golden; set aside.
In the same pot, cook onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Deglaze with white wine.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently, until each addition is absorbed before adding more.
When rice is creamy and tender (about 20 minutes), stir in mushrooms and parmesan.
